stdout:
Bring a target macOS app to the foreground before a foreground-dependent step.

Usage: auv invoke app.activate [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --target <TARGET>
          Required app:<bundle-id> (bare ids accepted); window and display targets are unsupported.

      --dry-run
          Validate the operation without performing it.

      --no-overlay
          Disable live visual overlay presentation.

      --store-root <PATH>
          Directory used to persist the recorded run and artifacts.

      --json
          Render machine-readable JSON output.

      --compact-json
          Render single-line JSON with all result, verification, failure, and artifact fields preserved.

      --detail
          Include diagnostic detail in human output.

      --wide
          Include extra columns in human table output.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  auv invoke app.activate --target com.apple.TextEdit
